# Best AI 3D Modeler

> A four-page guide to AI 3D model generators, current as of 9 November 2026: a ranked index, a methodology page, an about page and a pricing comparison, each with JSON-LD that matches the page. Meshy ranks first overall, Tripo is the best value for game assets, and Hyper3D Rodin is best for detailed hero assets. The other eight are Hunyuan3D, Hi3D, Sloyd, 3D AI Studio, Spline, Autodesk Flow Studio (Wonder 3D), Microsoft TRELLIS.2 and Kaedim. I didn't test any of the products hands-on, and the site says so throughout. Changes since the review: the API column now uses checked sources. Sloyd has a public API on prepaid credits (75 credits per US dollar, $12 minimum, about $0.33 for a textured text-to-3D model). Kaedim offers a Web API and webhooks as Enterprise features. Autodesk's public product and developer docs don't describe any API for Flow Studio or Wonder 3D. The release dates are now confirmed from Meshy's and Tencent's own sources: Meshy 7 became generally available on 10 Aug 2026, and Meshy 7.1 started rolling out on 10 Sep and reached the API on 18 Sep. Hunyuan3D 3.1 became selectable in the Tencent Cloud API on 20 Jan 2026. Four official pages blocked our reader or loaded empty: Tripo Studio pricing, Autodesk's Flow Studio page, Tencent's hosted Hunyuan site and its Tencent Cloud pricing doc. Prices that depend on those pages come from dated November 2026 guides and are marked 'reported'. The 'Related guides' line links bestinferenceproviders.com (for running open 3D models in the cloud) and bestaitoolsformarketing.com.

- [Best AI 3D Modeler (November 2026): 11 Tools Ranked](https://bestai3dmodeler.com/): The best AI 3D modelers in November 2026: Meshy, Tripo and Hyper3D Rodin lead 11 text- and image-to-3D tools, compared on features, pricing, licensing and drawbacks.
- [AI 3D Modeler Pricing Compared (November 2026)](https://bestai3dmodeler.com/ai-3d-modeler-pricing.html): Plan-by-plan pricing for Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Hunyuan3D, Hi3D, Sloyd, 3D AI Studio, Spline, Autodesk Flow Studio and Kaedim, checked 9 November 2026.
- [How We Ranked AI 3D Modelers | Best AI 3D Modeler](https://bestai3dmodeler.com/methodology.html): How the Best AI 3D Modeler list was researched and ranked: sources, criteria, what we could not verify, and what we left out.
- [About Best AI 3D Modeler](https://bestai3dmodeler.com/about.html): Best AI 3D Modeler is an independent research site that compares AI 3D model generators using vendors' public documentation and pricing.
